caption:
A call rings. You're on a roof, under a sink, mid-estimate.

Nobody answers.

Here's what happens when a system handles it instead of a person:

1. The missed call logs as a contact automatically
2. A text goes out at 42 seconds, quick and human
3. When they reply, the lead gets tagged hot and you get pinged
4. You send the booking link from the same thread. Job's on the calendar.

Example workflow, illustrative only, not a live client account.

Industry research shows only about 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour. Responding within 5 minutes can roughly double the close rate on that lead.

See it running on your own number. 14 days free, no card.
